boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Bristol-campus places with documented student uses, from collaborative work to campus traditions and community programs.

cards.title: The Roger Williams Statue
cards.subtitle: Campus quad
cards.notes: Stop by the quad sculpture for a campus photo; the university documents it as a tradition for incoming and graduating students.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus photo and good-luck landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says students pose with the statue as incoming and graduating students and often shake its hand before major exams.
cards.source_title: Creator of Beloved Roger Williams Statue on RWU Campus Dies at Age 87
cards.access_notes: Located on the Bristol-campus quad; follow any campus visitor guidance.

cards.title: University Library
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 15
cards.notes: Use the library as a map-listed academic stop; alumni programming specifically directs visitors there for campus-history displays.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed library with documented campus archive displays.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU's campus map lists the University Library, and its 2026 alumni weekend program locates an alumni archive display there.
cards.access_notes: Library access and services may vary; consult RWU before visiting.

cards.title: Intercultural Center
cards.subtitle: North end of Maple Hall
cards.notes: Bring an RWU ID and use the multipurpose room to study, socialize, unwind, or join an eligible campus program.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered gathering space with a multipurpose room and communal kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says the Intercultural Center's multipurpose room is for students to unwind, relax, study, socialize, and get involved.
cards.access_notes: RWU lists hours as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–6 p.m.; RWU ID is required to enter.

cards.title: Fine Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 11
cards.notes: Look for student visual-art work and, if you are enrolled, use the appropriate studio facilities with department guidance.
cards.short_summary: The home of RWU's traditional visual-arts disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says the Fine Arts Center houses Drawing, Painting, Sculpture, and Printmaking, with specialized student work spaces.
cards.access_notes: Studios and equipment are academic facilities; use them only with applicable authorization.

cards.entity_name: Richard L. Bready Applied Learning Laboratories
cards.title: Applied Learning Laboratories
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 28
cards.notes: For project-based coursework, use the building's open common spaces and whiteboards when your class or access permissions allow.
cards.short_summary: A lab building with documented student project-work spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU reports students using the building's open spaces and whiteboards to work on projects and chat between classes.
cards.access_notes: Laboratories and common spaces may be limited to authorized students and scheduled classes.

cards.title: Marine and Natural Sciences Building
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 18
cards.notes: Visit during an approved class, event, or tour to see the building that supports undergraduate marine research and aquaculture work.
cards.short_summary: A bayside science building with wet-lab and aquaculture facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says the building includes a Wet Lab, shellfish hatchery and farm, aquatic diagnostic laboratory, and greenhouse.
cards.access_notes: Research facilities are not general drop-in spaces; attend through class, tour, or approved event access.

cards.entity_name: Richard L. Bready Mount Hope Bay Sailing and Education Center
cards.title: Bready Sailing & Education Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 19
cards.notes: Use a scheduled class, sailing activity, or approved event to engage with this waterfront academic and team facility.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront center supporting sailing and educational activity.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU describes the center as the sailing team's home and an educational facility for students across campus.
cards.source_title: Richard L. Bready Mount Hope Bay Sailing and Education Center 'Puts RWU On the Map'
cards.access_notes: Waterfront and team facilities require appropriate authorization and activity supervision.

cards.title: Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 22
cards.notes: Check the university calendar for large student events and recreation opportunities hosted in the building.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed recreation building used for major student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU's 2026 Convocation page identifies the Campus Recreation Center as the location for the annual new-student ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Event attendance and recreation access depend on current schedules and university policies.

cards.title: Global Heritage Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 14
cards.notes: For career help, seek an appointment or posted drop-in session in GHH 117 through the Center for Career and Professional Development.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed academic building with documented career peer-advisor drop-ins.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU's Career and Professional Development Center lists Career Lab appointments with a Career Peer Advisor in GHH 117.
cards.source_title: Faculty & Staff – Center for Career and Professional Development
cards.access_notes: RWU lists Career Lab peer-advisor appointments in GHH 117 from 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; confirm availability first.

cards.title: The Commons
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination 16
cards.notes: Use this named dining destination when campus dining is open, and check current dining information before making plans.
cards.short_summary: The campus map's named dining-area destination.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU's campus map lists The Commons and marks dining areas and snack bars in its legend.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires checking current campus dining access and any applicable meal-plan or payment requirements.
